claims.citation: New York Herald, 15 July 1866, p. 3, col. 5
claims.verbatim:
Ship Progress, Woodward, Liverpool June 1, with mdse,
to Nesmith & Son. Had light W and SW winds from lon 30.
Crossed the Grand Banks in lon 49[?], and saw no ice. July
10, lat 40 10, lon 68 40, saw a vessel of about 150 tons bottom
up.

and 435 pass. to E. Cunard. June 9, in lat. 51 42, long. 27 14, passed
